scope: Broaden existing 7G.3d research across the TABLE DXF contract, current peer implementation limits, and a locally available AC1021 table-bearing DWG diagnostic trace; make parser and writer readiness separable without promoting support claims.

method.kind: Official Autodesk references, ODA specification §§20.4.96–20.4.101, primary peer source/docs and merged change history, read-only local source audit, and one existing local DWG smoke trace
method.sourcePinning: ACadSharp PR #1040 is pinned to merged commit 76d062b for this history observation. LibreDWG and ezdxf documentation URLs are mutable/current; no exact binary was run. Any future peer execution must bind an exact release/source, build options, input hashes and route.
method.evidenceRule: Autodesk DXF documentation defines published DXF fields and Autodesk API inheritance; ODA v5.4.1 governs DWG layout. Peer code, issue reports, project maturity labels and local diagnostic traces do not by themselves prove complete semantics or native acceptance.

evidence.topic: TABLE as native semantics plus display-block projection
evidence.observed: ACAD_TABLE derives from BlockReference and uses an anonymous *T block for displayed geometry. TABLESTYLE, owner, FIELD, block-cell, block-attribute, virtual-edge and repeated cell-value fields are separate obligations. For FIELD-backed text, Autodesk says the FIELD id is saved and text groups are ignored.
doesNotEstablish: that the local typed model represents all cell content variants
that *T geometry reconstructs native/editable table semantics
that a writer/readback is accepted by a native CAD application
evidence.planUse: Keep semantic cells, *T display projection, owner/style/cell-reference closure and native edit/render acceptance as separate evidence rows. Do not substitute static cell text for a FIELD or emit duplicate visible representations.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp merged DWG TABLE writer/read work
evidence.observed: PR #1040 merged on 2026-05-02 as commit 76d062b and adds/refactors TABLE entity DWG read/write support, including cell styles and references. Its recorded commit 2bb057e changes the linked-content flag to zero and skips linked-data details. The earlier maintainer statement that reads were partial in discussion #900 predates this merge and is not a current-master status claim by itself.
doesNotEstablish: correctness across all table/cell variants and DWG versions
native application acceptance or independent semantic correctness
evidence.planUse: Treat this as a useful feature/edge inventory. Pin a current package before optional runs and report skipped linked data and notifications explicitly; do not copy its disabled route as a format rule.

evidence.observed: The manual lists TABLE as working only pre-R2010, TABLECONTENT as unstable/undertested and TABLESTYLE as version-limited. The manual also documents class-level no-test and partial dispositions.
doesNotEstablish: a peer runtime result for any exact sample
complete coverage based on aggregate conversion statistics
evidence.planUse: Use LibreDWG only as a version/class-scoped comparator, not as a blanket TABLE oracle.

evidence.topic: ezdxf native TABLE versus primitive painter
evidence.observed: Documentation calls ACAD_TABLE unsupported and explicitly says TablePainter is unrelated to the native entity; it renders tables from ordinary DXF primitives.
doesNotEstablish: native TABLE cell editing or graph preservation
evidence.planUse: Use ezdxf only for a separately labeled projected-geometry check, never to fill native TABLE reader/writer support evidence.

sources: src/intern/dwgreader.cpp: dynamic entity dispatch and remaining-object diagnostics
evidence.observed: The existing local AC1021 file empirically reports dynamic entity oType 506 for TABLE; handles 0x2856e and 0x2a974 both reach TABLE CadValue stream failure with bufGood=1, strGood=0 and hdlGood=1, followed by R2007 TABLE cell parse incomplete and leftover handle-stream bytes. Whole-file export is independently stopped before publication by FIELD/FIELDLIST serializer preflight. The two conditions are distinct; the trace does not identify the root cause of string-cursor failure or qualify TABLE output.
doesNotEstablish: a root cause for the malformed/incomplete cursor state
successful TABLE semantics or output acceptance
evidence.planUse: Use this input only as a developer smoke trace. Add a generated parser control if the exact route can be reduced safely; keep field export gating independent so it cannot mask parser evidence. Do not commit or copy the source DWG.

implementationReadiness.existingOwnerOnly: 7G.3d / PAR-20; no new finding or top-level subplan
sequence: Keep generated DXF parser assertions for repeated/context-sensitive tags, text chunk ordering, field/block references, attributes, virtual-edge aliases, merges and following-record alignment.
Finish only narrow TABLESTYLE and cell graph profiles with unique staged identity remapping; preserve separate raw-carrier, typed DWG-origin and TABLE display-block routes.
Diagnose the AC1021 string/value/handle cursor failure against ODA §§20.4.96–20.4.101 before parseDwg changes; isolate read-side TABLE status from global FIELD/FIELDLIST DXF export preflight.
Add a separate AC1024+ embedded TABLECONTENT gate; do not infer it from AC1021 linked content or serializer round-trip.
Run the native render/edit check only at the composed consumer checkpoint after parser, adapter, graph and writer gates pass.
implementationReadiness.fastValidation: For each local slice, affected strict build, nearest generated test, LibreCAD_3 compatibility target and git diff --check; no full-suite or external peer runtime for this research update.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No fixture is committed or copied. Existing user-local sample is opt-in manual smoke evidence only; CI regression vectors must be generated from scratch in existing test executables.
